dog.name: Biscuit Went Walkabout
dog.desc: Mrs. Alvarez's terrier slipped his leash and ran off chasing trains.
steps: Find Biscuit. Mrs. Alvarez thinks he chases trains, so try the Ironworks Rail Spur.
Walk Biscuit home to Mrs. Alvarez on Brickrow Lane.

tools.name: Tools of the Trade
tools.desc: A Wharf Rat called Sticky Vic swiped Mara's red toolbox.
steps: Find Sticky Vic on the Canal Walk and take back Mara's toolbox.
Return the toolbox to Mara at Quinn Garage.

escort.name: The Long Way Round
escort.desc: Mr. Hollis is too frightened of the Wharf Rats to visit his sister at Pier Square.
steps: Walk Mr. Hollis safely along the Canal Walk to Pier Square. Keep him out of trouble!

score.name: Settle the Score
score.desc: Lacey swears Pip cheated his way to the Starlight high score.
steps: Ask around the arcade: talk to Pip, Marv at the snack bar, and the kid by the back machines.
score.reward_text: Token Jacket (TEC +2), $50, 100 XP for the right answer

cup.name: Alley Cat Cup
cup.desc: Big Mo runs a no-weapons street tournament in the alley behind the arcade. Entry is $10.
steps: Win the Alley Cat Cup: clear 3 rounds in Big Mo's Alley within 90 seconds.

parcels.name: Return to Sender
parcels.desc: Three Bellwether Courier parcels were stolen and stashed around town.
steps: Find the 3 stolen parcels hidden in crates, barrels or trash: Canal Walk, Yard Gate, Marquee Strip.
Bring the parcels back to Teddy at the Market Gate.
